backups.title: Backups
backups.intro: The daily backup of the whole wiki, a copy off the server and how to go back.
backups.run_failed: The backup failed. The details are in the audit log and the server log.
backups.schedule_desc: Once a day everything is backed up: the database, uploaded files and sealed documents, which stay encrypted. Old ones are rotated automatically.
backups.time_hint: Server time. Pick a quiet hour.
backups.keep_hint: This applies to daily backups. Of the pre-update ones the last 3 are kept; the others are not rotated: delete them from the list below.
backups.dir_hint: Change it in kudawiki.yaml (backup.dir): where the server writes is not chosen from the web.
backups.remote_desc: S3-compatible storage (MinIO, AWS, Wasabi…). Each backup is uploaded encrypted with the backup key, and once a week the latest one is test-restored from there.
backups.no_key: The backup key is missing: nothing is uploaded without it. Create it on the server with
backups.endpoint_hint: Empty, backups stay only in the server folder.
backups.prefix_hint: Optional: the folder inside the bucket.
backups.secret_hint: Stored encrypted and never shown. Leave it as is to keep it.
backups.path_style_hint: Required by MinIO and most self-hosted servers.
backups.restore_intro: Restoring is done from the server console, with the wiki stopped. What is there now is not deleted: it is kept in a before-restore folder next to the data.
backups.restore_after: After the restart everyone has to sign in again. The full procedure is in docs/operacion/respaldos-y-recuperacion.md.
backups.list_hint: Daily backups are kept as set above; of the pre-update ones, the last 3; manual ones, until you delete them. The last one tested to restore and the ones taken before deleting everything cannot be deleted. A downloaded backup has all the content unencrypted: keep it as safe as the server.
backups.delete_intro: It is deleted from the server folder and cannot be undone. If it was uploaded to the offsite destination, that copy stays.
backups.reset_desc: Leaves the wiki empty with only your account: deletes every area with its pages, files and sealed documents, the personal spaces, the templates and the other accounts. The site settings and the audit log stay. A full backup is taken and test-restored first; if that fails, nothing is deleted.
backups.reset_done: Everything was deleted. The backup taken before is in the list, in case you need to go back.
backups.reset_failed: Nothing was deleted: the backup before could not be taken or could not be restored. The details are in the server log.
error.invalid_backup_settings: Check the values: the time looks like 03:00, and the destination needs a valid https endpoint and bucket.
error.backup_locked: That setting is fixed in the configuration file: change it there.
error.backup_key_missing: The backup key is missing on the server: nothing can be uploaded encrypted without it.
error.backup_running: A backup or a reset is already running. Wait for it to finish.
error.backup_protected: That backup cannot be deleted: it is the last one tested to restore or the one taken before deleting everything.
ldap.title: Directory (LDAP / AD)
ldap.intro: The connection to your company directory: Active Directory, OpenLDAP, FreeIPA or another LDAP server. Tests use what is in the form, even if you have not saved it.
ldap.insecure_warning: The directory certificate is not verified: anyone on the network could impersonate it and see passwords. Load the internal CA and turn that option off.
ldap.enabled_hint: While on, saving only works if the connection test passes.
ldap.flavor_hint: It only changes the search and attribute defaults. The connection test suggests it.
ldap.urls_hint: One per line, with ldaps:// or ldap://. With several domain controllers, they are tried in order and the first that answers is used.
ldap.start_tls_hint: Required with ldap://: the connection is always encrypted. It does not apply to ldaps://.
ldap.ca_file_hint: Path on the wiki server to the PEM CA that signs the directory certificate. It is added to the system CAs.
ldap.insecure_hint: Only to get out of a bind: it leaves a warning at every start and on this screen.
ldap.bind_dn_hint: A read-only account: the wiki never writes to the directory.
ldap.bind_password_hint: Stored encrypted and never shown. If you change the servers or the account, type it again.
ldap.domain_netbios_hint: To accept COMPANY\ana when signing in.
ldap.user_base_dn_hint: People are only looked up under this branch.
ldap.default_hint: Empty uses the directory type's value, shown in grey.
ldap.login_attrs_hint: Comma-separated. What the person types is looked up in any of them.
ldap.group_base_dn_hint: Where the groups that will grant access to areas live.
ldap.disabled_filter_hint: An account that matches it cannot sign in even with the right password. Empty uses the directory type's filter.
ldap.attrs_guid_hint: An attribute that stays the same when the name or email change. Without one, the DN is used, and moving or renaming the entry creates another account.
ldap.attrs_photo_hint: The person's photo in the directory; it replaces the one uploaded in the wiki. Empty: the default for the server type is used.
ldap.password_help_url_hint: The company page to change or recover the network password. The wiki shows it on the login screen and in the profile.
ldap.precreate_users: Create the accounts of people in a mapped group in advance
ldap.precreate_users_hint: So content can be assigned to them or reading requested before they first sign in.
ldap.sync_interval_hint: Between 5m and 24h. It detects who left among those who do not sign in again.
ldap.sync_max_removal_ratio_hint: If a sync would remove more access than this percentage, it stops without applying anything and notifies the superadmins.
ldap.force_body: The connection test failed. If you save anyway, directory users might not be able to sign in until it is fixed. It is recorded in the audit log.
ldap.suggestion_type: Looks like {flavor}, with the identity in {guid}.
ldap.code.unreachable: Could not reach the server: check the name, the port and that the firewall lets the connection through.
ldap.code.invalid_url: The server address is not valid.
ldap.code.ca_file: Could not read the internal CA: check the path and that the file holds a PEM certificate.
ldap.code.tls_unknown_ca: The certificate is issued by a CA the wiki does not know: load the internal CA in the CA file.
ldap.code.tls_hostname: The certificate is not for that name: use the name on the certificate in the address.
ldap.code.tls_expired: The server certificate has expired: it has to be renewed in the directory.
ldap.code.tls_failed: Could not encrypt the connection. With ldap://, check that the server accepts StartTLS.
ldap.code.cert_expiring: The certificate expires in less than 30 days: renew it before the connection stops working.
ldap.code.bind_invalid_credentials: The directory rejected the service account: check the DN and the password, and that the account is not locked or expired.
ldap.code.bind_failed: The directory did not accept the service account.
ldap.code.timeout: The server did not answer in time.
ldap.code.base_not_found: That branch does not exist in the directory, or the service account cannot see it.
ldap.code.search_failed: The directory did not accept the search: check the filter.
ldap.code.no_users: Nobody matches the filter under the user base.
ldap.code.guid_from_dn: No identity attribute: the account depends on the DN, and moving or renaming the entry would create another one.
ldap.user_test_hint: Looks a person up the way sign-in will, without their password. Attribute names are shown; values only for email, name and identity.
ldap.user_not_found: “{login}” was not found with the user filter.
ldap.user_ambiguous: The filter finds more than one person, so it does not identify them: sign-in would fail. Adjust the filter or the sign-in attributes.
ldap.user_disabled: Found, but the account is disabled: they could not sign in.
ldap.user_missing: The entry has no {attrs}: check the attributes.
error.ldap_locked: That setting is fixed in the configuration file: change it there.
error.ldap_password_required: You changed where it connects: type the service account password again. If it is in the configuration file, change the servers there too.
error.ldap_test_failed: Not saved: the connection test failed. The details are below.
error.ldap_unavailable: Could not reach the directory. This is what the server or the network answered:
error.ldap_already_linked: That account already signs in with the directory.
error.last_local_superadmin: It is the last superadmin with a local password: if the directory fails, nobody could sign in to administer.
error.ldap_no_mapped_group: That person is not in any mapped group: the next sync would offboard them.
error.ldap_user_not_found: Not in the directory, or there is more than one entry, or it is disabled.
error.ldap_sync_running: A sync is already running: wait for it to finish.
ldap.group_member_filter_hint: How a person's groups are found. {dn} is their DN and {uid} their uid; groups inside groups are resolved automatically, up to 10 levels.
ldap.rules_intro: Each rule gives a role in an area to the people in a directory group, nested groups included. If several rules give access to the same area, the highest role wins. Only people in a group with a rule can sign in to the wiki.
ldap.rules_empty: There are no rules yet: nobody from the directory can sign in.
ldap.rules_need_connection: To search for groups, first save the connection with the group base.
ldap.rule_search_none: No group with that name under the group base.
ldap.rule_search_more: There are more groups: type more of the name.
ldap.rule_preview: “{group}” gives {role} in {area}. Enabled people in the group, nested groups included: {n}.
ldap.rule_preview_accounts: Already signed in to the wiki: {accounts}. Of them, {added} join the area and {raised} get a higher role; the rest get it when they first sign in.
ldap.rule_preview_truncated: The group is larger than what could be walked through: the real number is higher.
ldap.rule_remove_body: “{group}” stops giving {role} in {area}. People who only got in through this group lose that access the next time they sign in.
ldap.code.no_mapped_group: Not in any group with a rule: they could not sign in to the wiki.
ldap.code.no_group_base: Without a group base, their groups and the areas they would get cannot be shown.
ldap.status_code.login_unavailable: a login could not reach the directory
ldap.status_code.sync_unavailable: the sync could not read the directory
ldap.status_code.sync_failed: the sync failed while applying the changes
ldap.sync_aborted_short.removal_ratio: stopped: it removed too much access
ldap.sync_aborted_short.empty_group: stopped: a group came back empty
ldap.sync_aborted_short.truncated: stopped: a group is too large
ldap.sync_aborted.removal_ratio: Nothing was applied: it would remove more access than the limit. Check the directory; if the change is right, force it.
ldap.sync_aborted.empty_group: Nothing was applied: the group {group} came back empty and had members before. Check the directory; if the change is right, force it.
ldap.sync_aborted.truncated: Nothing was applied: the group {group} is too large to read whole. Split it in the directory.
ldap.sync_no_rules: There are no group rules: there is nothing to sync.
ldap.sync_would: This is what the sync would do (nothing was applied):
ldap.sync_memberships: Access added: {added} · changed: {changed} · removed: {removed} of {managed} ({ratio}; limit {max})
ldap.sync_reason.no_mapped_group: no longer in any mapped group
ldap.sync_conflicts: These accounts were not created because the email belongs to another account: {emails}
ldap.sync_force_body: {removed} access grants will be removed and {deactivated} people offboarded. Offboarding deactivates now and transfers their content when the grace period ends; reactivating before loses nothing. It is recorded in the audit log.
ldap.debug_hint: Logs every step of login and sync (filters, DNs, groups; never passwords) for 30 minutes.
error.ldap_group_not_found: That group is no longer under the directory's group base.
error.ldap_mapping_exists: That group already has a rule in that area: change that rule's role instead.
audit.ldap.mapping_update: Changed the role of a directory group rule

proposals.merged_same: Approved by {name}; the page already said that, so there was no new revision.
proposals.rejected_line: Rejected by {name}. You can fix it and resubmit it, or withdraw it.

editor.comment_placeholder: Optional: the author will see it

settings.override_none: No exceptions: the whole area uses the same mode.

secret.warn_title: Keeping passwords in documentation isn't recommended

personal.audit_banner: Audit mode: you are reading someone else's personal space. It is read-only, and everything you open is recorded in the audit log.
publish.title: Publish to an area
publish.will_move: Published directly in {area}: the page moves with its whole history and leaves your personal space.
publish.will_propose: {area} requires approval for that path: a proposal is sent and the draft stays here until it is reviewed.
publish.no_areas: You are not an editor in any area. To publish, ask an area admin to give you that role.
audit.page.publish: Published a page from their personal space
audit.personal.audit_open: Opened a personal space in audit mode
me.title: My home
me.intro: What is waiting for you in all your areas. Your drafts are in
me.watching: Recent changes in what I follow
me.watching_empty: You are not following any page yet. Follow pages with the bell button on each page.
reading.title: Reads
reading.intro_admin: The area's read requests: who opened each page and who confirmed reading it.
reading.intro_editor: The read requests you made: who opened each page and who confirmed reading it.
reading.empty: No read requests yet. Request them from a page's menu.
reading.no_candidates: There is nobody to pick: no one else has access to this page.
reading.statement_default: I confirm I have read and understood this document.
reading.ask_hint: They get a notification. You see who opened the page and who confirmed reading it; if the page changes, you can ask them to confirm again.
reading.notice: {name} asked you to read this page.
reading.notice_due: {name} asked you to read this page by {date}.
reading.page_changed: The page changed since the request: it is now on revision {n}.
reading.nobody: Nobody receives this request now: no one else has access to the page.
email.read_request.subject: You were asked to read “{title}”
email.read_request.title: You have a page to read
email.read_request.p1: Hi, {name}. In the {area} area you were asked to read “{title}”.
email.read_request.p2: Open it, read it and confirm at the end that you read it.
email.read_reminder.subject: Confirm you read “{title}”
email.read_reminder.title: The read due date is close
email.read_reminder.p1: Hi, {name}. You have {days} days left to confirm you read “{title}”, in the {area} area.
email.read_reminder.p2: Open it and confirm at the end that you read it.
error.invalid_audience: Check who you are asking: an editor can only ask viewers, and every person must be able to see the page.
error.invalid_read_request: Check the request: the due date must be in the future and the text up to 500 characters.
error.page_changed: The page changed while you were reading it. Reload it and confirm the new revision.
settings.quizzes_hint: When off, the area's quizzes are hidden and cannot be taken; results are kept.
settings.watermark_hint: N3 pages and sealed documents always show, faint and repeated, the reader’s name, email and time, with the company logo, on screen and when printed. Turn this on to add N2 pages.
quiz.title: Quiz
quiz.new_hint: It starts as a draft: nobody sees it until you publish it.
quiz.page_changed: The page changed since you published the quiz: check the questions.
quiz.dirty: There are unpublished changes: people taking it still see the published version.
quiz.open_to_readers: Open: anyone who can read the page can take it, without being asked
quiz.time_limit_hint: 0 = no limit. When it runs out, it is graded with what was answered.
quiz.shuffle_options: Shuffle the options (never for true or false)
quiz.pick_hint: 0 = all. With a number lower than {total}, each attempt picks them at random.
quiz.feedback: What is shown at the end
quiz.feedback_wrong: The score and which questions were wrong
quiz.reveal: When the right answers are shown
quiz.reveal_after_final: On passing or running out of attempts
quiz.delete_confirm: The draft will be deleted. A published quiz is not deleted: it is archived.
quiz.preview_hint: The trial uses the draft and does not count: it does not appear in the results.
quiz.question: Question
quiz.time_limit: Time limit: {min} minutes. When it runs out, it is graded with what you answered.
quiz.privacy: It is open book: you can go back to the page while answering. Results are used to know whether the procedure was understood; they are not used to assess your performance.
quiz.no_attempts: You used all your attempts. If you need another, ask whoever assigned it to you.
quiz.review_section: Review this section of the page
notif.kind.quiz_assigned: You were assigned the quiz for “{title}”
notif.kind.quiz_reminder: {days} days left to pass the quiz for “{title}”
notif.kind.quiz_failed_out: {actor} used all their attempts without passing “{title}”
notif.kind.ownership_received: You are now in charge of what {actor} had in {area}
email.quiz_assigned.subject: You have a quiz: “{title}”
email.quiz_assigned.title: You have a page to read and a quiz to pass
email.quiz_assigned.p1: Hi, {name}. In the {area} area you were asked to read “{title}” and pass its quiz.
email.quiz_assigned.p2: It is open book: you can go back to the page while answering.
email.quiz_reminder.subject: Pass the quiz for “{title}”
email.quiz_reminder.title: The quiz due date is close
email.quiz_reminder.p1: Hi, {name}. You have {days} days left to pass the quiz for “{title}”, in the {area} area.
email.quiz_reminder.p2: You will find it at the end of the page.
email.quiz_extra_attempts.subject: You have extra attempts on “{title}”
email.quiz_extra_attempts.title: You were given more attempts
email.quiz_extra_attempts.p1: Hi, {name}. {actor} gave you extra attempts on the quiz “{title}”, in the {area} area.
email.quiz_failed_out.subject: {actor} did not pass “{title}”
email.quiz_failed_out.title: Someone used all their attempts without passing
email.quiz_failed_out.p1: Hi, {name}. {actor} used all their attempts on the quiz “{title}”, in the {area} area, without passing it.
email.quiz_failed_out.p2: You can give them extra attempts from the reads panel. If several people miss the same questions, maybe the page does not explain it well.
email.ownership_received.subject: You received what {actor} had in {area}
email.ownership_received.title: You are now in charge of this
email.ownership_received.p1: Hello, {name}. {actor} left the wiki and what they had in the {area} area passed to you: {count} items among pages you now own, quizzes and read requests.
email.ownership_received.p2: The pages keep their history. From now on you get their review reminders and see the results of those quizzes and read requests.
email.role_changed.subject: Your role in {area} is {role}
email.role_changed.title: Your access to an area changed
email.role_changed.p1: Hi, {name}. {actor} gave you the {role} role in the {area} area of {site}.
email.role_changed.p2: It changes what you can read and do in the area. If you think it is a mistake, talk to whoever runs the area.
notif.kind.share_pending: {actor} asked to share “{title}” with other areas
notif.kind.share_pending_many: {count} new requests to share; the latest, “{title}”
notif.kind.share_ended: “{title}” is no longer shared with other areas: its level went up
notif.kind.sealed_admin_access: {actor} opened your sealed document “{title}” with the master key
notif.kind.sealed_reset_approved: {actor} approved resetting the password of your sealed document “{title}”
email.share_pending.subject: Request to share in {area}: {title}
email.share_pending.title: There is a request to share an article
email.share_pending.p1: Hi, {name}. {actor} asked to share “{title}”, from the {area} area, with other areas.
email.share_pending.p2: As an area admin, you decide whether it is shared. If you approve it, it shows up in Shared in those areas, read-only and always in its current version.
email.share_approved.subject: “{title}” is shared with {target}
email.share_approved.title: Your article was approved for sharing
email.share_approved.p1: Hi, {name}. {actor} approved sharing “{title}”, from the {area} area, with {target}.
email.share_approved.p2: It now shows up in that area's Shared. While it is shared, every change goes through a proposal.
email.share_rejected.subject: “{title}” is not shared with {target}
email.share_rejected.title: Your article was not approved for sharing
email.share_rejected.p1: Hi, {name}. {actor} did not approve sharing “{title}”, from the {area} area, with {target}.
email.share_rejected.p2: The reason is in the request, on the article's page. Once you change what was missing, you can ask again.
email.shared_received.subject: {from} shared “{title}” with {area}
email.shared_received.title: An article arrived in Shared
email.shared_received.p1: Hi, {name}. The {from} area shared “{title}” with the {area} area. It already shows up in Shared, read-only.
email.shared_received.p2: As an area admin, you can remove it from Shared if it is of no use to the area.
email.share_ended.subject: “{title}” is no longer shared
email.share_ended.title: An article stopped being shared
email.share_ended.p1: Hi, {name}. “{title}”, from the {area} area, went up a level and stopped being shared with other areas: only N1 pages are shared.
email.share_ended.p2: If it goes back to N1 and you want to share it again, it has to be requested again.
email.sealed_admin_access.subject: {actor} opened your sealed document “{title}”
email.sealed_admin_access.title: An admin opened your sealed document
email.sealed_admin_access.p1: Hi, {name}. {actor} opened the sealed document “{title}”, from the {area} area, with the wiki master key. They can read it, not edit it.
email.sealed_admin_access.p2: The access was recorded in the audit log. If you did not expect it, talk to whoever runs the wiki.
email.sealed_purged.subject: The sealed document “{title}” was deleted
email.sealed_purged.title: A sealed document was permanently deleted
email.sealed_purged.p1: Hi, {name}. {actor} permanently deleted the sealed document “{title}” from the {area} area. It cannot be recovered.
email.sealed_reset_approved.subject: You can now set a new password for “{title}”
email.sealed_reset_approved.title: Password reset approved
email.sealed_reset_approved.p1: Hi, {name}. {actor} approved resetting the password of the sealed document “{title}”, from the {area} area.
email.sealed_reset_approved.p2: Open it with your session and set a new one: nobody else knows it. The approval lasts 24 hours. If you did not ask for it, talk to whoever runs the wiki.
email.line.share_ended: “{title}” is no longer shared with other areas ({area})
email.line.quiz_assigned: You were assigned the quiz for “{title}” ({area})
email.line.quiz_reminder: {days} days left to pass the quiz for “{title}” ({area})
email.line.quiz_failed_out: {actor} used all their attempts without passing “{title}” ({area})
audit.quiz.attempt_timeout: Ran out of time on a quiz
error.quiz_required: This read is confirmed by passing its quiz.
error.invalid_quiz: Check the quiz: each question needs text and options with the right answer, and the settings must be valid.
error.quiz_cooldown: You cannot try again yet: there is a wait between attempts.
error.quiz_published: A published quiz cannot be deleted: archive it.
totp.title: Two-step verification
totp.required_note: It is required for your role and cannot be turned off. If you lose your phone, ask a superadmin to reset it.
totp.off_hint: Besides your password, signing in asks for a code from an app such as Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or Authy.
totp.scan: Scan this code with the app on your phone.
totp.qr_label: QR code for the authenticator app
totp.manual: Can't scan it? Type this key into the app:
totp.code_hint: The 6 digits the app shows right now.
totp.codes_hint: If you lose your phone, each code lets you sign in once. Keep them outside the wiki, in a password manager or on paper: they are not shown again.
totp.required_body: Your account ({email}) administers the wiki or an area, which requires two-step verification. Set it up to continue.
totp.login_hint: The 6 digits from your app, or one of your recovery codes.
admin.totp_reset_confirm: This removes {name}'s two-step verification and recovery codes. If it is required for their role, they will set it up again when they sign in. Only do this once you have confirmed that person is the one asking.
error.totp_required: Two-step verification is required for your role.
error.invalid_code: The code is not correct or was already used.
error.mfa_expired: Too much time passed. Enter your password again.
audit.auth.totp_lockout: Locked out after wrong verification codes
audit.auth.totp_recovery_used: Signed in with a recovery code
audit.admin.cli_reset_2fa: Reset two-step verification from the console
reauth.title: Confirm it's you
reauth.hint: What you're about to do requires confirming who you are. The confirmation lasts 10 minutes in this session.
error.reauth_required: You need to confirm who you are to do this.
audit.auth.reauth: Confirmed their identity for a sensitive action
sessions.title: Open sessions
sessions.hint: Where your account is signed in right now. If you don't recognize one, close it and change your password.
admin.sessions_revoke_confirm: All of {name}'s open sessions, on every device, will be closed. They will have to sign in again.
admin.link_intro: Find {name} in the directory. Their content, areas and history stay theirs.
admin.link_effect: Once linked, they sign in with the network password: the local password is deleted, their sessions are closed, and the email and name come from the directory.
admin.link_done: {name} now signs in with the directory ({email}).
admin.offboard_intro: The account is deactivated now: their sessions are closed and they cannot sign in. What they had is transferred, and what was never published is deleted, on {date}. If you reactivate the account before then, nothing is lost.
admin.offboard_pending_intro: The account is already deactivated and offboarding completes on {date}. You can complete it now.
admin.offboard_to_you: The area has no admin: you receive it.
admin.offboard_needs_admin: They are the last admin of {area}. Name another admin before completing the offboarding.
admin.offboard_delete: Personal pages: {pages} · Personal files: {media} · Personal sealed documents: {sealed} · Drafts: {drafts} · Returned or withdrawn proposals: {proposals}
admin.offboard_keep: The revisions they wrote, their pending proposals, their quiz attempts and their acknowledgements are kept with their name. The audit log stays intact.
admin.offboard_now: Complete the offboarding now, with no grace period
admin.superadmin_grant_confirm: {name} will be able to manage the whole wiki: people, areas, branding, email and the audit log. They will be asked for a second factor when they sign in.
admin.superadmin_revoke_confirm: {name} stops managing the wiki. They stay in their areas with the same roles.
passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.hint: Sign in with your device's fingerprint, face or PIN, or with a security key, without typing your password. They also work as the second step and to confirm it's you.
passkeys.name: Passkey name
passkeys.name_hint: To recognize it later, for example "Laptop" or "YubiKey".
passkeys.unsupported: This browser does not support passkeys.
passkeys.login_step: Confirm with your passkey: your device's fingerprint, face or PIN, or your security key.
passkeys.setup_hint: Instead of the app: this device's fingerprint, face or PIN, or a security key. If you lose it, a superadmin restores your access.
error.passkey_invalid: The passkey could not be verified. Try again.
error.cannot_change_self: That cannot be done to your own account: ask another superadmin.
error.already_offboarded: That person has already been offboarded.
error.offboarding_pending: That person is already being offboarded.
error.user_inactive: That account is deactivated: reactivate it first.
error.invalid_receiver: The receiver has to be an admin of the area.
error.area_needs_admin: An area would be left without an admin: name another one before completing the offboarding.
error.passkeys_unavailable: This wiki does not support passkeys: it needs an https address.
error.invalid_passkey_name: Give it a name of up to 64 characters.
error.passkey_cancelled: It did not finish: it was cancelled or timed out.
error.passkey_exists: This device already has a passkey registered to your account.
admin.people_desc: Who has an account, how they sign in and which areas they belong to. Invitations, two-step sign-in and offboarding are in each row's menu.
admin.areas_desc: Each area is isolated: non-members can't even see its name. Open an area to change its details or members.
admin.invite_hint_email: They get an email with a link to set their password. It's valid for 7 days.
admin.invite_hint_manual: Email isn't set up: you'll see the link once, to hand over yourself through a secure channel.
admin.areas_none: There are no areas yet. Create the first one to get started.
admin.area_desc: Address /w/{slug}. Change its name, description and members here.
admin.area_slug_fixed: The superadmin changes the address; the old one keeps working for members.
members.desc: Who can enter this area and with which role. Readers read, editors write, admins also configure.
members.add_hint: The person must already have a wiki account. If they're already a member, their role changes.
area_admin.title: Manage area
area_admin.general_desc: The area's name and which features are on.
area_admin.publishing_desc: Whether changes go live on save or wait for an admin's approval.
area_admin.content_desc: How many versions are kept and how often pages are checked to still be current.
area_admin.name_section_desc: What members see on the area's home page and in the area switcher.
area_admin.approval_desc: With approval, what an editor writes stays as a proposal until an admin accepts it.
ldap.server_desc: Where the directory is and how the connection is encrypted.
ldap.account_desc: The service account the wiki uses to look people up. Read access is enough.
ldap.search_desc: Where to search from and which filter tells people apart from other entries.
ldap.attrs_desc: Which directory attribute holds each piece of the person's data.
ldap.sync_desc: How often the directory is checked to update details, groups and leavers.
smtp.server_desc: Your company's mail server and how the connection is encrypted.
smtp.account_desc: The account the wiki signs in with and the address its emails come from.
appearance.identity_desc: The name shown in the top bar, the browser tab and the sign-in page.
appearance.preview_desc: How the wiki looks with the chosen colors. It applies to everyone on save.
appearance.logos_desc: They're saved on upload, without Save. SVG, PNG or WebP.
appearance.save_note: Saving reloads the page with the new branding.
audit.intro: What was done, by whom and when. Filter by person, action or dates.
